# ModDB — performance-fix history and withdrawal

- Original title: Robin Hood - Performance Fix
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.moddb.com/games/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/downloads/robin-hood-performance-fix1)
- Author / publisher: BertHunter; ModDB; community comments
- Language / date: English and Russian; uploaded 2016-01-17; author follow-up 2017-06-04
- Access: File description, archival notice, and displayed comments inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

BertHunter’s launcher bundled game-specific ddwrapper and DXWnd configurations, font fixes, and resolution handling. The uploader has archived it as outdated and unsupported. In June 2017, the author instead recommended dgVoodoo2 while acknowledging occasional loading hangs.

Comments document executable-name detection problems in a localized Gold edition and an unresolved purple display after renaming. A later Russian commenter reports missing text after switching wrappers, then says the issue was resolved without explaining how. This preserves the provenance and limitations of a commonly linked fix; no archive was downloaded or configuration tested.
